_comment: Single source of truth for open roles. build.py turns each OPEN job into JobPosting structured data on its page, an ItemList on /apply/, and the /jobs.json + /jobs.xml feeds. To close a role set status to "closed" (it then disappears from all of them). Keep every fact here identical to what is visible on the job page. Closing dates are automatic: 14 working days after datePosted (weekends and content/holidays.json skipped). Optional per job: "workingDaysOpen" or an exact "validThrough" date. "remote": true marks a fully remote role.

jobs.title: Pastry Chef (Assistant)
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Pastry Chef (Assistant) for a restaurant in Maitama, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.
responsibilities: Assist the pastry chef in preparing and baking pastries, cakes, bread and desserts to the restaurant's standard.
Prepare doughs, fillings, ingredients and decorations ahead of service.
Keep the pastry section clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
Help monitor stock and report shortages.
qualifications: At least 2 years' relevant pastry or kitchen experience
Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision
Able to commute to Maitama, Abuja and resume immediately

jobs.title: Sous Chef
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Sous Chef for a restaurant in Maitama, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.
responsibilities: Support the head chef in running the kitchen day to day and lead the cooks during service.
Prepare and cook dishes to a consistent standard and check quality before food leaves the kitchen.
Supervise kitchen staff and enforce food safety and hygiene standards.
Help with stock control, ordering and keeping waste low.
qualifications: At least 2 years' experience as a sous chef or in a similar kitchen role
Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision
Able to commute to Maitama, Abuja and resume immediately

jobs.title: Storekeeping Assistant
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Storekeeping Assistant for a production company in Kuje, Abuja.
responsibilities: Receive, check and record incoming materials and finished goods.
Issue items to production staff and keep accurate stock records.
Keep the store clean, organised and secure, and report any shortages.
benefits: Hands-on experience in a production company.

jobs.title: Real Estate Sales Manager
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Real Estate Sales Manager in Kado, Abuja. This is a sales-driven role with a real estate focus.

jobs.title: Business Strategy Officer
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Business Strategy Officer for our consulting team. This is a remote role open to applicants in Nigeria.
responsibilities: Analyse client businesses and recommend practical strategy, structure and growth plans.
Support business development by preparing proposals and presentations and following up on opportunities.
Support HR and organisational design projects for clients and report progress to the team.
qualifications: 2 Years' Experience in Business Development, Consulting or HR
benefits: Hands-on consulting experience with Nigerian businesses.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.summary: We are hiring an Accountant in Gwarimpa, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for an experienced accountant.
responsibilities: Keep accurate books of account and prepare regular ledger and bank reconciliations.
Prepare and file tax and other statutory returns on time.
Prepare monthly financial reports for management.
qualifications: B.Sc or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field

jobs.title: Tech Sales Closer
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Tech Sales Closer for our sales team. This is a remote role open to applicants in Nigeria, with a base pay of ₦100,000 per month plus uncapped commission on closed deals.
responsibilities: Close warm leads by taking qualified prospects from first call through to a signed deal.
Keep a clear pipeline: record every lead, follow up on proposals and report on deals closed.
Work to a monthly sales target.
benefits: Uncapped commission on every deal you close.

jobs.title: Chef
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Chef for a restaurant in Maitama, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role.
responsibilities: Prepare and cook meals to a consistent standard of quality for restaurant guests.
Plan menus and portions, and suggest new dishes.
Keep the kitchen clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards.
Monitor stock, order ingredients and keep waste low.
qualifications: At least 2 years' experience as a chef
Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision
Able to commute to Maitama, Abuja and resume immediately

jobs.title: Sales Assistant
jobs.summary: We are hiring a Sales Assistant for a clothing store in Wuse 2, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for a presentable, confident communicator who is comfortable handling fabrics and can resume immediately.
responsibilities: Welcome customers, understand what they are looking for and help them choose the right clothing and fabrics.
Handle, fold and display fabrics and clothing with care, and keep the shop floor tidy.
Keep the store presentable and report stock and customer requests to the store management.
qualifications: 1-2 Years' Experience in Sales or Retail
Able to commute to Wuse 2, Abuja and resume immediately
